story.hero.title: Sleeping badly does not always have the same cause.

story.recognition.title: Maybe you have been trying to sleep better for a while.
story.recognition.body: Some things help for a few days. Others change nothing. Sleeping badly is not one single experience, and trying solutions without understanding the pattern can increase frustration.
story.recognition.reflection2: You have tried advice, routines, or apps.
story.recognition.reflection3: You have looked for a solution that works for you.
story.recognition.reflection4: You still do not know which information matters.

morpheo.faq.title: Clear questions before you begin.
morpheo.faq.a1: Morpheo is an initial guidance tool that organizes the information you share about your sleep and helps you understand possible next steps.
morpheo.faq.a2: No. Morpheo does not confirm or rule out conditions, prescribe treatments, or replace a consultation with a healthcare professional.
morpheo.faq.q3: How long does the guidance take?
morpheo.faq.a3: The time may vary depending on the information you share. The experience is designed so you can proceed calmly and review your answers.
morpheo.faq.q4: Is there a version for professionals?
morpheo.faq.a4: Morpheo Pro prepares structured, reviewable information to support a more informed clinical conversation without replacing professional judgment.
morpheo.final.title: Before trying again, start by understanding.
